paite: Ka sikha, ka let gige, ka tel, ka lung in apahtak mahmah en dih ua; atung ah ka kha ka koihta; Zentelte kiang a piak ding in vaihawmna thu ahong pawt ding.
heading: TOUPA Sikha
english: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.

paite: Akikou kei ding a, a-aw asuaksak sam kei ding, kongzing ah a-aw akizasak sam kei ding.
english: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.

paite: Sialluang gawpsa akuaitan kei ding a, meikuang liakliak amitsak kei ding; thudik in vai ahawm zaw ding hi.
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.

paite: Leitung a vaihawmna a-omsak masiah, amah abah kei ding a, alungdong sam kei ding; tuikulh gamte'n adan thu angak nilouh ding uhi.
english: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice on the earth, and the islands wait for his law.”

paite: Pathian, TOUPA, van siampa leh phalhpa, lei leh asung a kipan a pawt tengteng hihlianpa, atung a mite kiang a hatna pepa leh atung a paite kiang a kha pepa'n hichi in achi:
english: God Yahweh, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it, says:

paite: "Kei TOUPA in diktatna in ka hon sam a, na khut ka len ding a, ka hon humbit ding, mite thukhun hi ding leh Zentelte hihvakpa hi ding in ka hon sep ding a;
english: “I, Yahweh, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations,

paite: mitdelte mit hihvak ding leh mitangte suangkul a kipan pikhe ding leh, mial lak a tute suangkul a pan pikhe ding in.
english: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.

paite: "TOUPA ka hi; huai ka min ahi; ka thupina midang kiang ah ka pe kei ding a, phat ka lohna leng milim bawltawmte kiang ah ka pe sam kei ding.
english: “I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.

paite: Ngai un, tuma thilte ahong tungta, thil thakte gen ka hi; apou ma in nang ka hon hilh hi.
english: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”

paite: Tuipi a hoh sukte leh asung a om tengteng leh tuikulh gamte leh, atung a om tengtengte aw, TOUPA pahtawi in la thak sa unla, kawlmong a kipan in leng amah phatna la sa un.
heading: Phatna La Khat
english: Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.

paite: Gamdai leh akhote'n a-aw uh suaksak uhen, Kedarte omna khuate'n; suangpi khua a omte'n nuamsa in la sa uhenla, mual dawn a kipan kikou uhen.
english: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!

paite: TOUPA hih thupi uhenla, tuikulh gamte'n aphatna thu gen uhen.
english: Let them give glory to Yahweh, and declare his praise in the islands.

paite: TOUPA lah mihat mahmah bang in apawt ding a, galdoumi bang in mullitna atokthou ding; akikou ding a, ahi, ngaihtak in akikou ding; amah doute tung ah hattak in agamtang ding.
english: Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.

paite: Sawtpi ka daita a; ka om kinken in ka kidek teitei; tu'n zaw numei nauvei bang in ka kikou tuaituai ding a; ka nak honhon in ka nak huhu ding.
heading: Pathian In Amite Panpih Achiam
english: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.

paite: Tang leh mual pawngte ka hihse ding a, aniam tengteng ka keusak vek ding; luite tuikulh gam in ka bawl ding a, dilte ka kangsak ding.
english: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.

paite: Mittawte atheih ngei louh lam uah ka pi ding a, atheih ngei louh uh lampi ah ka pi ding; ama uah mial vak in ka bawl ding a, lam kawinate leng ka tangsak ding. Huai thilte ka hih ding a, amau leng ka nuse kei ding.
english: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.

paite: Milim bawltawmte muang a, milim sunte kiang a, ka pathian uh na hi uh, chite kiheisak in a-om ding ua, nakpitak in azahlak ding uhi."
english: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.

paite: Bilngongte aw, za un; mittawte aw, na muhtheihna ding un en un.
heading: Israel Theihsiam Theihlouhna
english: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.

paite: Ka sikha lou ngal kua mit ataw a? Ahihkeileh, ka sawltak sawl bang in kua bil angong a? Hon kithuahpih mi bang in kua mit ataw a? TOUPA sikha bang in kua mit ataw a?
english: Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as Yahweh’s servant?

paite: Thil tampi na mu a, himahleh na lungsim in na vom gige kei; abilte akihong a, himahleh aza kei hi.
english: You see many things, but don’t observe. His ears are open, but he doesn’t listen.

paite: Dan lah adiktatna ziak a letsak a pahtawisak a om TOUPA'N hoih asa hi.
english: It pleased Yahweh, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.

paite: Himahleh hiaite zaw guta guksak leh loh tuak mite ahi ua; phaizang a ahi vek ua, suangkul a khummangte ahi ua; sal kaih ding ahi ua, kuamah in lah ahumbit ngal kei ua, gallak a lak ding ahi ua, kuamah in, "Pe nawn in!" achi kei uhi.
english: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become captives, and no one delivers, and a plunder, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’

paite: Na lak uah huaite bildoh ding kua na om ua? Hun hong tung ding a dia ngaikhia a za ding kua na om ua?
english: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?

paite: Kua'n ahia Jakobte gallak a lak ding a pia a, Israelte gutate kiang a pia? TOUPA, atung a i khelhnapa un, apiak hilou hia? Ama lampi ah apai nuam ngal kei ua. Adan thu amang sam kei uhi.
english: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t Yahweh, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.

paite: Huaiziak in aheh mahmahna leh kibawlna tha amau tung ah asungbua a, huai in amaute akang a himahleh athei sam kei uh; huai in amaute ahul a, himahleh alungsim un angaihtuah tuan kei uhi.
english: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle. It set him on fire all around, but he didn’t know. It burned him, but he didn’t take it to heart.”
